Introduction.SourceString: 如果能有评定，应该会是收容组内「被异象骗最多次」的人。
Introduction.LocalizedString: If there was such a ranking, I'd probably hold the record for "Most Times Tricked by Anomalies" in the Containment Units…

Content.SourceString:
梦想是成为异象管理局收容组骨干！薄荷选手，出动！
大概是整个收容组最喜欢出外勤的成员，大热天也不例外。逮着出勤闲隙可以偷吃一支碎雪冰淇淋，更不用说回局里后还能申请高温补贴。
与外勤任务频率旗鼓相当的，是薄荷参加局里补考的频率。

「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」忠实用户，并勇于尝试所有新味道。尝试指的是闻闻气味，薄荷是不会舔自己的尾巴毛的！
和娜娜莉的相识起源于两只手同时伸向了店里最后一瓶护理喷雾！娜娜莉的伊波恩古董店伙伴们都很亲切！浔前辈……绝对是很有故事的人！

欸欸欸欸！出外勤时又「捡到」了安魂曲前辈！这个时候果然要联络可靠的副队长……用户暂时无法接听？难道在开会？完蛋了，白藏前辈和法帝娅前辈，薄荷哪一个都招架不来><

哈！又是向收容组骨干努力迈进的一天！把这个异象送进临时收容层后，大概就可以下班了吧？

嗅嗅，是薰衣草小姐来了！旁边的陌生又温暖的可可味是……
Content.LocalizedString:
My dream is to become a CSU Ace! Player Mint, ready to go!
She probably loves field work the most among all the Containment Units members. She even loves it on scorching hot days. She can sneak a Blizzi Ice Cream during downtime, and won’t hesitate to apply for heat allowance when she gets back to the bureau.
The frequency of Mint's makeup exams at the bureau perfectly matches her field mission frequency.

Loyal user of Fluffy Tail Care Spray, she’s brave enough to try all the new scents. By try, she means sniffing them… Mint would never lick her own tail fur!
Her friendship with Nanally started when both their hands reached for the last bottle of care spray in the store! The partners at Nanally's Eibon Antique Shop are all so nice! Hotori Senpai… definitely has some stories to tell!

Ehhhhh! Found Lacrimosa Senpai again during field work! At times like this, I should definitely contact our reliable Lieutenant… User currently unavailable? Must be in a meeting. I'm doomed! Mint can't handle either Baicang Senpai or Fadia Senpai!

Ha! Another day working hard toward becoming a CSU Ace! Once I get this anomaly into Temporary Containment, I can probably clock out, right?

Sniff sniff, Lavender is here! And that unfamiliar but warm Coco scent next to her is…

Content.SourceString:
薄荷其实也是伟大的柯林斯家族一员——准确讲，编外成员。
收到娜娜莉·柯林斯抛来的橄榄枝后，薄荷思考了许久，认真程度不亚于准备异象管理局的补考。
首先！薄荷非常认可这位天才少女！
其次！家族听起来很酷！薄荷喜欢和朋友们（以后就是家族成员们）待在一起！
最重要的是：薄荷最不擅长的，就是拒绝别人！
然而最终薄荷还是拒绝了娜娜莉的提案，承诺她作为家族的「编外成员」会时不时来伊波恩看看。
因为——收容组的工作非常非常忙，万一娜娜莉要临时召开家族会议，薄荷可不能保证马上就能赶过来。那样薄荷就会变成不守时的家族成员，不得不打破家族的规矩！
家族最重要的是规矩，就是这样。
Content.LocalizedString:
Mint is actually a member of the great Colucci family too… well, to be exact, an honorary member.
After receiving Nanally Colucci's olive branch, Mint thought long and hard about joining, with the same seriousness she puts into preparing for makeup exams.
First! Mint totally respects this genius girl!
Second! A family sounds really cool! Mint loves hanging out with friends (family-members-to-be)!
Most importantly: Mint is worst at saying no to people!
However, Mint ultimately declined Nanally's proposal, promising that as an honorary member of the family, she'd drop by Eibon from time to time.
Because… Containment Units work is super, super busy, and if Nanally suddenly called a family meeting, Mint couldn't guarantee she'd be able to rush over right away. That would make Mint a tardy family member, and she'd be breaking the family rules!
The most important thing about a family is the rules. That's just how it is.

Title.LocalizedString: Kittens always grow up so fast

Content.SourceString:
孩童成长为少年过程中的必经之痛，年少时最难忘却的回忆。因疼痛半夜从睡梦中惊醒，在一次次舒展身体间变得挺拔。
然而对薄荷来说，这种物理性质的痛似乎不曾存在。
可能是个子抽条时年纪太小，不到10岁就抵达现在的海拔，也可能是天性大条对成长带来的变化反应异常迟钝。那个夏天可能有过的迷茫困惑与关节时隐时现的疼痛，和崭新未开封的暑假作业一起被忘在了脑后。
Content.LocalizedString:
There is an inevitable pain that comes with becoming a teenager—its the most unforgettable memory of a child. Waking up in the middle of the night from an ache, growing taller with each stretch of the body…
But for Mint, this physical pain was never present.
Maybe she was too young when her growth spurts hit; she reached her current height before she was 10. Maybe her naturally carefree nature made her unusually slow to react to the changes that come with growing up. Whatever anguish that summer’s on-and-off joint pain might have brought got left behind along with her brand new, unopened summer homework.

Content.SourceString:
尴尬的年纪，尴尬的身高。她比同龄人唐突高出那么大一截，总能被不知情者误认为是大上好几岁的高中生姐姐。薄荷这个「大块头」和小伙伴们玩不到一起去，似乎不算什么太意外的结果。
薄荷喜欢爬到树上晒着太阳午睡，叼着草叶偷偷看一眼邻居家的孩子们打打闹闹。然后那么不经意地……至少要表现得像顺手为之地帮忙把他们卡在树杈上的风筝摘下来。
「小不点」同学突然在她的半梦半醒间出现，薄荷至今都还记得自己栽下树时的狼狈模样。
脸庞稚嫩的小家伙开口招呼她：「喂，小鬼。」
Content.LocalizedString:
An awkward age, an awkward height. She towered so much over her peers that strangers would mistake her for a high school student several years older. It wasn't too surprising that Mint, as such a "big kid," couldn't really play with her little friends.
Mint liked climbing trees to nap in the sun, a blade of grass between her teeth as she secretly watched the neighbor kids play and fight. Then, casually… or at least trying to make it look casual, she'd help get their kites unstuck from the branches.
"Tiny" suddenly appeared during one of her half-asleep moments, and Mint still remembers how embarrassing she looked tumbling out of that tree.
The young-faced little guy called out to her: "Hey, kid."

Content.SourceString:
「小不点」同学赠送的糖果色挎包，内装有同色系笔记本。纸页洁白光滑，非常漂亮。
双手插兜，非常酷的「小不点」同学，临别前送给薄荷如此幼稚可爱的礼物，强硬辩解称「适合你这样的小屁孩。」
偶遇了外表看起来是小孩，实际在异象管理局工作的眼力毒辣的可靠成年人！小不点与大块头在暑假展开了难忘的历险！小不点帮助大块头更好掌握自己的异能！小不点是大块头最重要的朋友！小不点与大块头未来还要再见面！
薄荷小朋友，在夏天的尾巴抓住了自己的梦想：加入异象管理局，和「小不点」同学（以后是「小不点」前辈）再见面。
让郁闷燥热的暑期一下子清凉起来的冰镇可乐——她的气味，在不远的未来等着自己。
Content.LocalizedString:
A candy-colored waist bag gifted by "Tiny," with a matching notebook inside. The pages are clean, smooth, and absolutely beautiful.
Hands in pockets, super cool "Tiny" gave Mint the childish, adorable gift before parting, stubbornly defending it as "perfect for a little brat like you."
She met someone who looked like a kid, but was actually a sharp-eyed, reliable adult working at the Bureau of Anomaly Control! Tiny and Big Kid had an unforgettable adventure that summer! Tiny helped Big Kid better control her Esper Ability! Tiny is Big Kid's most important friend! Tiny and Big Kid will meet again in the future!
Little Mint achieved her dream at summer's end: join BAC and reunite with "Tiny" (who'll be "Tiny Senpai" by then).
Like an ice-cold cola that instantly cools down a stuffy, sweltering summer… her scent awaits in the not-so-distant future.

Content.SourceString:
诱人的胖达火锅牛油锅底，酸甜的碎雪莓果冰淇淋，苦涩香醇的「菲女士」倒满的咖啡。
所熟悉所喜爱的日常点滴，以气味的形式在记忆中书写下浓墨重彩。
放松心情，深呼一口气……感受此刻，随风缓缓流淌的生活之味。
Content.LocalizedString:
The tempting beef tallow base of Panda Hotpot… The sweet and tangy Blizzi Berrie Ice Cream… The bitter yet rich aroma of coffee poured full by Ms. Fei…
Familiar, beloved daily moments write themselves in bold strokes engraved in memory through their scents.
Relax, take a deep breath… feel this moment, the flavors of life flowing gently on the breeze.

Content.SourceString: 呀嚯！是收容二组的薄荷！有什么需要帮忙的尽管找我，可可！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey there Coco, Mint's the name, and I'm your go-to gal from CSU-2. Need a hand? Just call!

Content.SourceString: 呜呜……又挂了吗……明明都说戴上这家的护身符就没问题的……
Content.LocalizedString: Did I fail again? Waah… They told me I'd pass if I wore this amulet…

Content.SourceString: 碎雪又出了新品！任务完成后就去尝尝看吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Blizzi rolled out a new ice cream! Can't wait to give it a whirl after the mission!

Content.SourceString: 这次收容行动的资料已经发送到邮箱了么……呃呜……好多页……
Content.LocalizedString: The briefing for this containment op has been sent via email… Uwa… so many pages…

Content.SourceString: 嗯~这么好的天气，要不去申请个外勤任务逛……巡逻吧！这肯定不算偷懒，嗯嗯！
Content.LocalizedString: Mmm, what a day! Perfect for some fieldwork… I mean, a totally legit patrol. Not slacking, promise!

Content.SourceString: 呜呃……沾上雨水的话，尾巴毛又要结块了……
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… Rain makes my tail clumpy…

Content.SourceString: 呼……这个温度，感觉又会被前辈们当成暖手宝……
Content.LocalizedString: With this weather, I'm gonna be a walking, talking hand warmer for the senpai…

Content.SourceString: 好热……回去之后我要申请高温补贴！
Content.LocalizedString: It's so hot… I'm filing for a heat bonus when I get back!

Content.SourceString: 早上好啊！嘶——哈，好！可可能量，FULL CHARGE！
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning! Sss—great, Coco Power! Full charge!

Content.SourceString: 没想好吃什么的话，就跟我一起去吃卜多力的热舞章鱼烧吧！不过，这次你可得记得提醒我小心别烫到哦。
Content.LocalizedString: If you can't decide what to eat, join me for Budoriya's Dancing Takoyaki! But remind me to blow on them first.

Content.SourceString: 夜间的海特洛市可是跟白天大不相同的哦！哼哼，今天就让我带你去开开眼界！
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau's nightlife is a whole new world! Hehe, I will be your tour guide!

Content.SourceString: 诶，已经这么晚了吗？可我还一点都不困呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Eh, this late already? But I'm wide awake!

Content.SourceString: 喜欢的事情？逛街！嗯……这么说好像不太对？欸不管了！我啊，很喜欢去从没去过的地方，进到那儿的店里逛逛，什么店都可以。如果店主和里面的客人愿意跟我聊聊天的话，就更好了！嘿嘿……下次要不要跟我一起来？会遇到好多好多有趣的事情的！
Content.LocalizedString: What do I like to do? Shopping! Well… that doesn't sound quite right. Eh, never mind! I love window shopping and discovering new places. It's even better if the shopkeeper and fellow shoppers chat with me! Hehe… wanna come along next time? You'll find lots of interesting things!

Content.SourceString: 最近的一次考试又没有通过，呜……再这样下去要被扣工资了，大危机啊！明明已经很认真的背了条例，但是一看到试卷上密密麻麻的字，脑子里的东西就全都忘光了！
Content.LocalizedString: Failed another exam… If this continues, my pay's at risk! I did memorize all the rules, but the exam's dense text always blanks my mind!

Content.SourceString: 还记得我们当时一起泯除的那个画框吗？就算是现在想想，也还是觉得它的奇点有些不可思议呢，只是夸它一句就能让它心甘情愿消失什么的……你说，那些千奇百怪的异象，会不会也是这样，想要的……其实只是简单得让人想不到呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Ever think about that frame we nullified together? Its Nexus still gives me the wows. It's like it just needed a little appreciation to leave it all behind… Makes you wonder if those quirky anomalies out there are just looking for something… surprisingly simple.

Content.SourceString: 不知道吃些什么？问我可算你找对人了！海特洛市好吃的东西，上到名扬四海的网红店，下到犄角旮旯里的路边摊，我可是最有发言权的人！当、当然那种太高端的饭店，暂时还给不出什么意见……但是！只是暂时哦！作为异象管理局的骨干精英，早晚有一天我会升职加薪然后吃遍整个海特洛市的！
Content.LocalizedString: Hungry and indecisive? You've hit the jackpot with me! I'm your ultimate guide to Hethereau's yummiest bites, from network-famous spots to secret street eats. Fancy places? Don't know much yet… but just you wait! I'm on my way up in the BAC, and soon, I'll be the foodie queen of the town!

Content.SourceString: 这瓶畅爽汽水给你！刚才又中了「再来一瓶」，欸嘿嘿，我这方面的运气还蛮好的呢，之前还中过超——低价的卜多力豪华套餐券哦！为什么运气这么好考试还蒙不对？这、这个……前辈们说这叫「运气守恒定律」……
Content.LocalizedString: Here, you can have this soda! Just got myself a bonus bottle! My luck's been off the charts lately—scored a Budoriya mega-deal meal voucher once! Why isn't my exam luck so hot? Well, the senpai swear by the Luck Conservation Law…

Content.SourceString: 有一次，我悄悄听到组里的同伴跟薰衣草小姐在讨论关于我的事情，说我……像那个……夏天约会时吹来的风？什么「一股脑把精心准备的发型给吹乱，但总归又让人会心一笑，真是不知道说什么好」……可可，你说他们说的是什么意思啊，是在数落我还是在夸我呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Caught my team chatting with Lavender, calling me "the summer breeze on a date"—messy hair but a smile-maker, a real paradox. What do you think, Coco? That's a compliment, right?

Content.SourceString: 每次去吃拉面或者章鱼烧的时候，直到进店之前都还在提醒自己吹凉了再吃，但是一有人跟我搭话，我就总是会忘记这一点，然后就又被烫到了……呜，可可，就连你也笑话我……
Content.LocalizedString: Whenever I get ramen or takoyaki, I always tell myself, "Cool it before you eat!" But then, someone strikes up a conversation, and poof! I forget and—ouch—burnt again! Waah… Even you get a giggle out of it, Coco…

Content.SourceString: 只要我跟朋友们呆在一起，深吸一口大家身上暖暖的气息，不管多累，都能立刻恢复活力哦！就像这样——嘶——哈——嗯~薄荷选手，完全复活！
Content.LocalizedString: When I'm with my buddies, their cozy vibes are like a power-up! No matter how wiped I am, one big whiff of that friend-fueled warmth like this… agh… and bam! I'm all zippy again—just like that!

Content.SourceString: 薰衣草小姐真的超——厉害！能帮局长把这么多的琐事管理得井井有条，不管怎么想都很厉害吧！而且，就算她的工作那么忙，见到我的时候也会很热情地问好呢！当，当然，如果能不要每次我迟到的时候都恰好经过的话，就更好了！
Content.LocalizedString: Lavender is AMAZING—keeping the director's agenda in perfect order. And she's always so warm when she sees me, even with her busy schedule! Of course, it would be better if she didn't always "happen to pass by" when I'm late!

Content.SourceString: 浔前辈？我、我……我真的什么都不知道！呜……不是我不讲义气，是我下次可不想被揪着耳朵从伊波恩扔出去……这个世界上最困难的事情，除了通过考试就是在浔前辈面前撒谎啦！什么都瞒不过她的！
Content.LocalizedString: Hotori Senpai? I… I don't know anything! Waah… It's not that I'm disloyal, I just don't want to be thrown out of Eibon by the ear next time… The hardest things in this world are passing exams and lying to her! She sees through everything!

Content.SourceString: 局长真的好可怕！哪怕我只是闻到她的气息，尾巴上的毛就要炸了！如果跟局长的目光对上的话……呜！好可怕好可怕！要我去局长的办公室，我宁可在夏天跑一周的外勤！
Content.LocalizedString: The director is really scary! Just a whiff of her scent, and my tail's fur stands on end! If our eyes meet… Oh! So scary! I'd rather do a week of fieldwork in the summer than go to her office!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多是我最可靠的盟友，我们可是约好要在「超人日记」上相互监督打卡竞争积分第一的！变强必要的修行哪里能少得了最基础的体能锻炼呢？欸，说到这里，上次我们绕桥间地夜跑五十圈的伟大计划……是被什么紧急事态耽误了来着？
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo is my most reliable ally. We've promised to keep each other accountable on Superman Diary and race to the top of the leaderboard! Gotta keep working out if you want to get stronger, right? Oh, that reminds me of our epic fifty-lap night run last time… what emergency delayed us again?

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉之前偷偷接过一个超厉害的委托，带着早雾和埃德嘉溜进了一片超级危险的异象空间！听她说，那次经历可真是惊心动魄险象环生呐！还好有她那招「柯林斯终极幽魂暗影裂空霆焰魔拳」才能成功化险为夷！后来有好一阵没看见她，听说是被浔前辈关了禁闭……唉，天才总是很难被世人认可啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally took on a super tough commission, sneaking into an extremely dangerous Anomalous Realm with Sakiri and Edgar! She said it was a heart-stopping, perilous adventure! Thankfully, her Colucci Ultimate Death Shadow Nether Punch saved the day! Haven't seen her for a while after that. Heard Hotori senpai grounded her… Ah, it's hard for geniuses to be recognized in this world!

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生？可靠！令人安心！在需要的时候能受到阿德勒先生的帮助，就像是你在考场上发现自己没带铅笔，然后后座的同事贴心地递给你一支崭新的，还带着香味的铅笔一样安心。那叫……我记得阿德勒先生告诉过我来着……哦对对，雪松！
Content.LocalizedString: Mr. Adler? Reliable and reassuring! Getting his help feels like a colleague handing you a brand-new pencil just when you realize you forgot yours in an exam. What's that scent called again? Mr. Adler told me before… Oh yeah, cedar!

Content.SourceString: 猜猜草莓牛奶小姐是谁？哼哼，猜不到吧，答案当然是我们安魂曲前辈！没想到吧！为什么不是番茄的味道？这哪有什么为什么，而且，你不觉得迷迷糊糊的安魂曲前辈跟草莓牛奶很配吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Guess who's Strawberry Milk? Hehe, bet you can't tell—it's our one-and-only Lacrimosa Senpai! Surprised? Why isn't she tomato-flavored? Well, no reason. And don't you think a dreamy senpai goes well with strawberry milk?

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩的大家虽然每天都吵吵闹闹的，但真的是一个很温馨的大家庭呢！我相信，伊波恩对可可来说一定是一个超级棒的归宿！
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon's a lively bunch, but it's one big cozy family at heart! I'm sure you'll find Eibon to be an awesome home!

Content.SourceString: 「每位成员都拥有以一敌百的力量」这样的描述，怎么会不让人激动啊！为什么会有人觉得只有怪人才能进E.T.D呢，他们是很酷很有个性，但也不乏有很多好说话的人呐！
Content.LocalizedString: "Each person an army." Isn't that thrilling? ETD is not just for eccentrics. They're cool, quirky people, but that doesn't mean that they can't be nice!

Content.SourceString: 工作闲下来的时候，我也会跟其他部门的同事们聊两句。异象管理局虽然做着制约异象的大事，但很多员工其实跟普通人是一样的，会因为像「孩子不听话啊」「物业费又涨了啊」这样的家常烦恼，也会因为「年假多了一天」「今天组长请我喝了奶茶」这些小事而高兴！
Content.LocalizedString: Chatty downtime with colleagues is the best! We deal with super important things at the Bureau of Anomaly Control, but we're all human—fretting over mischievous kids or groaning about bills. But it's the little joys, like an extra day off or surprise milk tea from the group leader, that make our day!

Content.SourceString: 刚进收容组的时候，我接连闯了好多祸。是前辈们一边笑我动不动哭鼻子，又一边默默加班陪着我。那时候我就在想，总有一日我也要成为前辈们那样可靠又温暖的人，「收容组骨干」的名号可是一点都不会比「E.T.D精英」逊色哦！
Content.LocalizedString: Starting in the Containment Unit was a rollercoaster. I got in trouble a lot, but the veterans were there for me, laughing at my tears but staying late to help me. I'm aiming to be the reliable and cheerful heart of the team, just as solid as any ETD Elite!

Content.SourceString: 要悄悄变强，然后吓前辈们一大跳！
Content.LocalizedString: Bam! The new and improved Mint!

Content.SourceString: 风的低语，听得更清楚了呢。
Content.LocalizedString: I can hear the wind's whispers more clearly now.

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，这才是收容组骨干薄荷的真实实力哦！
Content.LocalizedString: That's Mint for ya! Ace of the CSU!

Content.SourceString: 知薄荷者，非可可莫属！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco knows Mint best!

Content.SourceString: 我超喜欢！可可！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, I love it!

Content.SourceString: 哇哦~谢谢你可可~
Content.LocalizedString: Wow, thank you Coco!

Content.SourceString: 我需要管教管教我的尾巴——它开心到摇得停不下来！
Content.LocalizedString: I need to put my tail in its place… It's so happy, it won't stop wagging!

Content.SourceString: 别小看我！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't doubt me!

Content.SourceString: 刮飞你们！
Content.LocalizedString: Get blown away!

Content.SourceString: 站稳咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Stand firm!

Content.SourceString: 注意，别眨眼哦！
Content.LocalizedString: Watch out, don't blink!

Content.SourceString: 嘿，狂风过境咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Here comes the whirlwind!

Content.SourceString: 终极薄荷奥义之霹雳无敌托马斯回旋疾风斩！
Content.LocalizedString: Mint's Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash!

Content.SourceString: 你，跟得上风吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can you keep up with the wind?

Content.SourceString: 好嘞，把这玩意放进——哇呀！差点就白干了，好危险好危险。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, let's put this thing in… woah! Phew! That would've ruined my whole day's work! Gotta be careful…

Content.SourceString: 好嘞，把这玩意放进——哇呀！还好接到了，不然绩效就危险了。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, let's put this thing in… whoa! I can't drop that! Gonna ruin my performance bonus!

Content.SourceString: 好，向着成为可靠的薄荷前辈更进一步！
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, one step closer to becoming a reliable senpai!

Content.SourceString: 跟考试比起来，这种事简直就是小菜一碟~
Content.LocalizedString: Compared to exams, this is just a piece of cake.

Content.SourceString: 诶呀，这种程度的东西而已，平常心平常心~
Content.LocalizedString: Eh, it's nothing big. Easy peasy.

Content.SourceString: 哼~哼哼，还是一如既往地好运呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, as lucky as ever!

Content.SourceString: 嗯？刚刚是捡到了什么不得了的东西吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm? Did I just pick up something incredible?

Content.SourceString: 多亏有风的指引！
Content.LocalizedString: Thank the winds for guidance!

Content.SourceString: 这么多东西，口袋里要塞不下啦！
Content.LocalizedString: So much stuff, my pockets are bursting!

Content.SourceString: 嗯哼！今天的运气也很不赖嘛~
Content.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm! Another lucky day for me!

Content.SourceString: 呜呜……没力气了……
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… I'm getting tired…

Content.SourceString: 呀……事情有些大条了呢……
Content.LocalizedString: Yikes… things are getting serious!

Content.SourceString: 咦，眼前怎么在冒星星？
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? Why am I seeing stars?

Content.SourceString: 呼……！活过来了！
Content.LocalizedString: Phew…! I'm alive!

Content.SourceString: 薄荷队员，完全复活！
Content.LocalizedString: Mint, back in action!

Content.SourceString: ……要是能……再快一点的话……
Content.LocalizedString: If only I was… a little faster…

Content.SourceString: ……风，停了吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Has the wind… stopped…

Content.SourceString: ……对不起……又拖后腿了……
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry… I held everyone back again…

Content.SourceString: 小看我可是要付出代价的。
Content.LocalizedString: Underestimating me comes at a price.

Content.SourceString: 你的气味，让人有些讨厌呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Your scent is kind of unpleasant.

Content.SourceString: 嘁……失误了。
Content.LocalizedString: Tch… a minor mistake.

Content.SourceString: 不会有下次的！
Content.LocalizedString: No next time!

Content.SourceString: 好痛！
Content.LocalizedString: Ouch!

Content.SourceString: ……集中集中……
Content.LocalizedString: …Focus, focus…

Content.SourceString: 好嘞，收容组骨干薄荷，堂堂登场！
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, the CSU Ace is making an entrance!

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，大干一场吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, let's do this!

Content.SourceString: 在这儿呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Here it is!

Content.SourceString: 要当心咯！
Content.LocalizedString: Look out!

Content.SourceString: 清凉一下？
Content.LocalizedString: Want to cool off?

Content.SourceString: 呜呼~
Content.LocalizedString: Woohoo!

Content.SourceString: 乘着风的感觉！
Content.LocalizedString: Riding the wind!

Content.SourceString: 我来帮忙！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm here to help!

Content.SourceString: 由我搞定！
Content.LocalizedString: I got this!

Content.SourceString: 出勤出勤！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's go!

Content.SourceString: 我来了哟！可可！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm here, Coco!

Content.SourceString: 薄荷选手，接棒安魂曲前辈！
Content.LocalizedString: Player Mint, taking over from Lacrimosa Senpai!

Content.SourceString: 不会辜负白藏前辈的期待！
Content.LocalizedString: I won't let Baicang Senpai down!

Content.SourceString: 我会加油的！翳前辈！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll do my best, Skia Senpai!

Content.SourceString: 法帝娅前辈！我也会努力享受战斗的……嗯！
Content.LocalizedString: Fadia Senpai, I'll do my best to enjoy the fight like you!

Content.SourceString: 柯林斯家族编外成员，前来支援！
Content.LocalizedString: Honorary Member of the Coluccis is here to help!

Content.SourceString: 接下来就交给薄荷前辈我吧，茶茶！
Content.LocalizedString: Teana, let Mint senpai take over!

Content.SourceString: 我也来帮忙，果果！
Content.LocalizedString: Taya, I'm here to help!

Content.SourceString: 可可！你太拼命啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco! You're pushing yourself too hard!

Content.SourceString: 安魂曲前辈！快好好休息一下！
Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa Senpai, you need to take a break!

Content.SourceString: 法帝娅前辈！很、很厉害的那个癖好多少也得收着些吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Fadia Senpai! That c-crazy obsession… maybe dial back a little?

Content.SourceString: 弄伤我们柯林斯老大的家伙！薄荷是不会放过你的！
Content.LocalizedString: You're the one who hurt the Colucci boss! Mint won't let you get away with this!

Content.SourceString: 茶茶，不可以硬撑！
Content.LocalizedString: Teana, don't force it!

Content.SourceString: 又在勉强自己了，果果！
Content.LocalizedString: Taya, you're overdoing it again!

Content.SourceString: 抓到你了！
Content.LocalizedString: Gotcha!

Content.SourceString: 看好了！
Content.LocalizedString: Watch this!

Content.SourceString: 哇哦！不愧是我！
Content.LocalizedString: Whoa! Can't touch this!

Content.SourceString: 比风还要快噢！
Content.LocalizedString: Swifter than the breeze!
